# Optional Open CASCADE Technology dependency

Only unmodified license texts are stored here. No OCCT source or binary is vendored.

Upstream source/version: https://github.com/Open-Cascade-SAS/OCCT/tree/V7_9_2

- LICENSE_LGPL_21.txt: https://github.com/Open-Cascade-SAS/OCCT/blob/V7_9_2/LICENSE_LGPL_21.txt
- OCCT_LGPL_EXCEPTION.txt: https://github.com/Open-Cascade-SAS/OCCT/blob/V7_9_2/OCCT_LGPL_EXCEPTION.txt

The optional adapter dynamically links an OCCT >=7.9 SDK; the tested SDK is 7.9.2.
For local package versions and notices see the SDK `packages.json` and `usr/share/doc`.
